methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $9.17B (to $21.38B) × margin 15.7% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $18.43B

assets in place = NOPAT $1.43B ÷ WACC = $23.13B; value = ($23.13B + $4.52B − net debt $20.43B) ÷ 517,000,000 = $13.96
